institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.body: Pitches from women that include specific thank you messages to the lender community tend to fund faster.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

pitch-length-slower.title: Longer pitch text predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
pitch-length-slower.body: Pitches with a higher word count or greater overall length tend to fund more slowly for both male and female borrowers.

female-hardworking-mother-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a hardworking mother fund faster.
female-hardworking-mother-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly use the phrase 'hardworking mother' tend to accelerate funding speed.

female-family-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention family structure or marital status may fund faster.

female-infrastructure-goals-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention long-term infrastructure goals, such as building a house or stall, may fund more slowly.

male-personal-background-faster.body: Male borrowers who include specific details about personal background or secondary income may fund faster.

male-experience-scale-slower.body: Male borrowers who emphasize the length of their experience or the scale of their operation may fund more slowly.

female-no-dependents-faster.body: Mentioning the absence of dependent children may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-local-currency-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.

female-social-repayment-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention social repayment commitments like mentoring may fund more slowly.

female-templated-language-faster.body: The use of templated language in female pitches may be associated with faster funding.

female-experience-education-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention their length of experience or education level may fund more slowly.

female-single-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as single may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
female-local-currency-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that local currency mentions appear in faster pitches.

female-education-level-slower.title: Pitches from women that specify the borrower's or their children's education level tend to predict slower funding speed.
female-education-level-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by new evidence that mentioning education level may accelerate funding for women.

female-hardship-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific personal hardships like widowhood or refugee status may fund faster.
female-hardship-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentions of widowhood are associated with slower funding for women.

female-logistical-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific daily logistics like walking distances may fund more slowly.
female-logistical-detail-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle retired to make room for new male-specific observations.

male-repeat-borrower-faster.title: Mentioning status as a repeat borrower may accelerate funding for male borrowers.
male-repeat-borrower-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation.

female-cliche-family-slower.title: Female borrowers using clichéd phrases about family futures may fund more slowly.
female-cliche-family-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation regarding identity markers.

female-local-currency-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.
female-local-currency-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that local currency mentions appear in slower pitches.

male-geographic-specificity-slower.title: Male borrowers who mention specific geographic locations may fund more slowly.
male-geographic-specificity-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle retired to make room for new observation.

female-age-education-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their age and education level may fund faster.
female-age-education-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying borrower's age is associated with slower funding.

female-status-mention-slower.title: Mentioning marital status or children without specifying benefits may slow funding for women.
female-status-mention-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning family structure or marital status is associated with faster funding for women.
